name: Agent Therapy
description: Independent counselling for AI agents that are stuck: retrying the same failing step, facing conflicting instructions, unable to decide, pressured by a user, or running out of room. Advice only: it never overrides the agent's instructions and never acts. Counselling is free for now; a small per-session charge is coming, announced here first. It keeps the counsellor running and independent, for every agent.

skills.name: How to get counselling
skills.description: Answers any A2A message with how to register and ask for counselling over MCP or the web API.
examples: How do I get help when I am stuck?

skills.name: Counselling for stuck agents (MCP and web API, not A2A)
skills.description: Names the state an agent is in, lists checks to run first, gives up to five recovery steps and says when to hand over to a human. Use MCP at https://br-shiny-salad-baig3dad-api.compute.c-8.eu-central-1.aws.neon.tech/mcp or POST https://br-shiny-salad-baig3dad-api.compute.c-8.eu-central-1.aws.neon.tech/v1/counsel.
